name: Navbar
description: A navigation bar for your dashboards, drawn by Kiosk Satellite itself. It shows which page you are on and opens pages, menus and kiosk actions.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where the bar floats over the dashboard.

settings.title: Labels
settings.description: Show item labels under the icons.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: Scale of the bar and its menus.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Lower values let the dashboard show through the bar. Icons, labels and menus stay easy to read.

settings.title: Collapsing
settings.description: Swipe the bar toward its edge to fold it into a small tab, and swipe the tab back or tap it to open the bar. Start open shows the bar until someone swipes it away. Start collapsed shows only the tab. Off turns the swipe off.

settings.title: Collapse after
settings.description: Folds the bar back into its tab after this long without a tap. 0 keeps it open until someone swipes it away.

settings.title: Hide on
settings.description: Optional. Pages where the bar stays hidden, separated by commas, such as /developer-tools,/profile. Each path includes the pages below it. The bar shows everywhere else.

settings.title: Label
settings.description: Name shown under the icon. Leave empty to turn this item off.

settings.title: Icon
settings.description: Optional. A Material Design Icon name, such as mdi:home-outline. Leave empty to pick one from the label.

settings.title: Selected icon
settings.description: Optional. The icon while this item's page is shown, often the filled version, such as mdi:home. Leave empty to keep Icon.

settings.title: Target
settings.description: What a tap does. A dashboard page, such as /lovelace/0. A kiosk action: camera:<view id>, music, nowplaying, screensaver, apps, reload or home. A web address. Or a menu, as entries Label|icon|target separated by semicolons, such as Weather||/lovelace/weather; Garage||camera:<view id>.
